title: dixon's cool 1v1 datapack
description: 1v1 your friends battle-royale style with this cool datapack!!
body:
### Ever wanted to 1v1 your friends in Minecraft, battle-royale style? ![two players dueling at sunset](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ef630f4307e7cab0d4ed43823e5773dc2be35f8f.jpeg) This datapack allows for that! Featuring a built-in grace period, shrinking worldborder and the use of the underrated locator bar, this datapack provides a unique experience where players gather resources prior to fighting rather than traditional kit PvP. With the constantly shrinking border and the danger of revealing your location for even a moment, players have to weigh the benefits of gathering extra resources, or going on the hunt early for the element of surprise. # Setup This datapack has a fairly simple setup process. When you generate a world, it creates two platforms at the coordinates X: 100, Z: 100 and X: -100, Z: -100. The datapack works by checking for players with the tags: _player1_ and _player2_. **Type in:** ``` /tag add player1 ``` and ``` /tag add player2 ``` Replace __ with the names of the players who are participating. Once you're ready to start, type ``` /function battle:start ``` to begin! # Recommendations It is highly recommended that you use this datapack in a hardcore world to make winning/losing more impactful. In addition, during setup, it is recommended that you use repeating command blocks for the /tag commands to prevent any chance at players getting a headstart or unfair advantage.
Q: How long will a round take?
A: Typically, an average round will last around 30 to 40 minutes.
Q: Can I use this in my modpack?
A: Yeah! (as long as it is on Modrinth)
